senses.gloss: m. (חֲטַט I) digger; חַטֵּיט שכבי one who exhumes the dead, grave-robber.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:8">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה ח׳ ש׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>קא מְחַיֵּיט מערתא</he>, early eds. <cite ref="H00727"><he>חַיַּיט</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="H00294"><he>חוּט</he> I</cite>).—Pl. constr. <he>חַטִּיטֵי</he>.
